trust in virtual salesperson contains the same components as trust in human salesperson, but the formation process of trust in virtual and human salesperson are different.
the trust in a virtual agent is different from the trust in a human agent and is based on the competence, benevolenc, and integrity of the virtual agent.

trust in virtual salesperson is a construct with three dimensions: (1) competence, (2) benevolence, (3) integrity; and that trust in virtual and human salesperson is similar, but the formation processes are different.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of customer trust in online sales.
how to make computer agents trustworthy.
trust formation in a virtual sales context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the trust in a virtual agent is a combination of the trust in a human agent, the trust in the computer, the trust in an artificial intelligence and the trust in the company behind the agent.
trust in virtual salesperson can be compared with trust in a human, but not completely.
trust in a virtual and a human salesperson is similar, but not identical.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the trust in virtual salesperson is similar to trust in human salesperson, however the formation process is different.
trust in virtual salespeople can be enhanced by increasing perceived competence, benevolenece and integrity of the virtual salesperson.
virtual salespersons are trustworthy, but their trustworthiness is not perceived as easily as that of human salespersons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
virtual salespersons should be trustworthy, but not necessarily trustworthy in the same way as human salespersons.
trust in computer agents is a complex phenomenon and that trust is not a binary variable.
the design of a trustworthy virtual salesperson should focus on the formation process of trust in a virtual agent and on the formation process for distrust.
